description: This file defines the OperationManager class, which manages database operations within the Hive server, including creating, tracking, canceling, and retrieving operation results and logs.

classes.name: OperationManager
classes.description: Manages Hive operations, including creation, retrieval, cancellation, and log handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the operation manager with Hive configuration, setting up logging if enabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the operation manager (placeholder for additional startup logic).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the operation manager (placeholder for cleanup logic).

methods.name: initOperationLogCapture
methods.description: Sets up log capturing with a custom appender based on logging mode.

methods.description: Creates a new execute statement operation (unsupported in this stub).

methods.description: Returns the status of an operation.

methods.description: Attempts to cancel an operation if not already finished or aborted.

methods.description: Closes and removes an operation.
